study type: Retrospective cohort for predictive model development and validation
exposure: Fifty-five candidate risk factors routinely available on labor admission (unspecified)
cohort: Women who had births assessed for postpartum hemorrhage from 10 sites of the U.S. Consortium for Safe Labor Study (2002-2008).
finding: All predictive models showed good-to-excellent discrimination in predicting postpartum hemorrhage, with the extreme gradient boosting model having the best discriminative ability (C statistic: 0.93).
